fw_costa.name: Rafael Costa
fw_costa.hook: Ice-cold and silent; the most feared counter-striker in the division. Says nothing, lets his fists answer.
fw_costa.bio: Ice-cold and silent; the most feared counter-striker in the division. Says nothing, lets his fists answer.

fw_brady.name: Sean Brady
fw_brady.hook: The biggest mouth at 145 and the hardest worker — he wants Costa's blood and won't shut up about it.
fw_brady.bio: The biggest mouth at 145 and the hardest worker — he wants Costa's blood and won't shut up about it.

fw_tanaka.name: Hiro Tanaka
fw_tanaka.hook: Throws more in a round than most do in a fight. Humble, beloved, and impossible to pin down.
fw_tanaka.bio: Throws more in a round than most do in a fight. Humble, beloved, and impossible to pin down.

fw_lima.name: André Lima
fw_lima.style: jiu-jitsu finisher who hunts the choke
fw_lima.hook: A black-belt wizard — get careless on the mat for one second and the night is over.
fw_lima.bio: A black-belt wizard — get careless on the mat for one second and the night is over.

fw_hale.name: Marcus Hale
fw_hale.hook: Gym leader, blue-collar work ethic, smothers strikers against the cage for fifteen minutes.
fw_hale.bio: Gym leader, blue-collar work ethic, smothers strikers against the cage for fifteen minutes.

fw_karim.name: Yusuf Karim
fw_karim.hook: Seen it all. The measuring stick the young guns have to get past to prove they're real.
fw_karim.bio: Seen it all. The measuring stick the young guns have to get past to prove they're real.

fw_chen.name: Bao Chen
fw_chen.hook: Highlight-reel kicks from range — when he lands clean, it's a poster.
fw_chen.bio: Highlight-reel kicks from range — when he lands clean, it's a poster.

fw_marin.name: Diego Marín
fw_marin.hook: Walks you down and digs to the body until you fold. Pure Mexican warrior pace.
fw_marin.bio: Walks you down and digs to the body until you fold. Pure Mexican warrior pace.

fw_ellis.name: Tom Ellis
fw_ellis.hook: On a tear and fearless — the division's hottest rising name nobody wants to fight yet.
fw_ellis.bio: On a tear and fearless — the division's hottest rising name nobody wants to fight yet.

fw_dubois.name: Pierre Dubois
fw_dubois.hook: Awkward, rangy, point-perfect — a puzzle nobody enjoys solving.
fw_dubois.bio: Awkward, rangy, point-perfect — a puzzle nobody enjoys solving.

lw_tamiev.name: Aslan Tamiev
lw_tamiev.hook: Undefeated and unsmiling. Quiet faith, mountain strength — he mauls everyone and hasn't been tested yet.
lw_tamiev.bio: Undefeated and unsmiling. Quiet faith, mountain strength — he mauls everyone and hasn't been tested yet.

memories.text: Finally, someone worthy steps in front of me.

lw_tamiev.hype: 21-0 and never been hurt. The aura is real — everyone wants to be the one.

lw_cross.name: Jordan Cross
lw_cross.hook: The people's draw — fast, loud, electric, and desperate to be the one who hands Tamiev his first loss.
lw_cross.bio: The people's draw — fast, loud, electric, and desperate to be the one who hands Tamiev his first loss.

memories.text: My shot. The Mountain goes down Saturday.

lw_cross.hype: The biggest draw in the sport — sells out arenas, then backs every word up.

lw_mwangi.name: Leon Mwangi
lw_mwangi.hook: All length and timing; he fights at the end of his reach and picks you apart.
lw_mwangi.bio: All length and timing; he fights at the end of his reach and picks you apart.

lw_ferreira.name: Caio Ferreira
lw_ferreira.hook: Elbows, knees, and a furnace of a gas tank — he drowns people in the later rounds.
lw_ferreira.bio: Elbows, knees, and a furnace of a gas tank — he drowns people in the later rounds.

lw_walsh.name: Danny Walsh
lw_walsh.hook: One left hand can end any night. Crowd favourite, all action, never in a boring fight.
lw_walsh.bio: One left hand can end any night. Crowd favourite, all action, never in a boring fight.

lw_aliyev.name: Rustam Aliyev
lw_aliyev.hook: Tamiev's stylistic shadow — another wrestler who wants to prove he's the real one.
lw_aliyev.bio: Tamiev's stylistic shadow — another wrestler who wants to prove he's the real one.

lw_mori.name: Kenji Mori
lw_mori.hook: Baits the shot and takes the back; calm, technical, dangerous when underestimated.
lw_mori.bio: Baits the shot and takes the back; calm, technical, dangerous when underestimated.

lw_torres.name: Mike Torres
lw_torres.hook: Old-school hands and ring IQ; a tough out for anyone climbing the ladder.
lw_torres.bio: Old-school hands and ring IQ; a tough out for anyone climbing the ladder.

lw_novak.name: Pavel Novák
lw_novak.hook: Impossible to finish; you have to beat him for twenty-five hard minutes.
lw_novak.bio: Impossible to finish; you have to beat him for twenty-five hard minutes.

lw_balogun.name: Ade Balogun
lw_balogun.hook: Undefeated, freak athlete, fast-tracked — the future of the division if the hype is real.
lw_balogun.bio: Undefeated, freak athlete, fast-tracked — the future of the division if the hype is real.

mw_adeyemi.name: Kato Adeyemi
mw_adeyemi.hook: Devastating power and a megawatt smile — the champ-showman who turns the lights out and loves his team fiercely.
mw_adeyemi.bio: Devastating power and a megawatt smile — the champ-showman who turns the lights out and loves his team fiercely.
mw_adeyemi.hype: Nobody ends a night like Blackout. Must-see violence, every single time.

mw_romano.name: Luca Romano
mw_romano.hook: Cold, cerebral, and patient — he studies the tape and solves you like an equation.
mw_romano.bio: Cold, cerebral, and patient — he studies the tape and solves you like an equation.

mw_hutchins.name: Cody Hutchins
mw_hutchins.hook: Blue-collar hero — takes you down, leans on you, and never, ever quits.
mw_hutchins.bio: Blue-collar hero — takes you down, leans on you, and never, ever quits.

mw_khalidov.name: Ramazan Khalidov
mw_khalidov.hook: Silent, heavy, relentless on top; a nightmare to get out from under.
mw_khalidov.bio: Silent, heavy, relentless on top; a nightmare to get out from under.

mw_alves.name: Júnior Alves
mw_alves.hook: Spins everything — sometimes it's a highlight, sometimes a lesson, never boring.
mw_alves.bio: Spins everything — sometimes it's a highlight, sometimes a lesson, never boring.

mw_tonga.name: Wes Tonga
mw_tonga.hook: Enormous power in both hands; if he clips you, you're going home early.
mw_tonga.bio: Enormous power in both hands; if he clips you, you're going home early.

mw_brenner.name: Karl Brenner
mw_brenner.hook: Cold and constant — keeps walking, keeps throwing, never changes pace.
mw_brenner.bio: Cold and constant — keeps walking, keeps throwing, never changes pace.

mw_okeke.name: Sam Okeke
mw_okeke.hook: Adeyemi's young teammate on the rise — climbing toward an awkward collision with his own mentor's division.
mw_okeke.bio: Adeyemi's young teammate on the rise — climbing toward an awkward collision with his own mentor's division.

mw_hcosta.name: Hugo Costa
mw_hcosta.hook: Tidy, tough, and hard to look good against; a quiet spoiler of hype trains.
mw_hcosta.bio: Tidy, tough, and hard to look good against; a quiet spoiler of hype trains.

mw_demir.name: Bilal Demir
mw_demir.hook: Heavy hands plus a wrestling base — a well-rounded kid the matchmakers are watching.
mw_demir.bio: Heavy hands plus a wrestling base — a well-rounded kid the matchmakers are watching.

lhw_brandt.name: Viktor Brandt
lhw_brandt.hook: Never stops walking forward. A soft-spoken family man who turns into an unkillable engine the second the cage shuts.
lhw_brandt.bio: Never stops walking forward. A soft-spoken family man who turns into an unkillable engine the second the cage shuts.

lhw_banks.name: Tyrell Banks
lhw_banks.hook: Frightening fast hands and a frightening mouth — the brash kid who thinks the belt is already his.
lhw_banks.bio: Frightening fast hands and a frightening mouth — the brash kid who thinks the belt is already his.
lhw_banks.hype: Loud, undefeated, electric. The future of the sport showed up early.

lhw_petrovic.name: Goran Petrović
lhw_petrovic.hook: Mauls you in the clinch and grinds you down; old-school, mean, and heavy.
lhw_petrovic.bio: Mauls you in the clinch and grinds you down; old-school, mean, and heavy.

lhw_achebe.name: Moses Achebe
lhw_achebe.hook: All length and faith — humble out of the cage, terrifying reach inside it.
lhw_achebe.bio: All length and faith — humble out of the cage, terrifying reach inside it.

lhw_doyle.name: Liam Doyle
lhw_doyle.hook: You cannot hurt him and he will not stop coming; the bloodiest, most beloved scraps in the division.
lhw_doyle.bio: You cannot hurt him and he will not stop coming; the bloodiest, most beloved scraps in the division.

lhw_sokolov.name: Anton Sokolov
lhw_sokolov.hook: Slams you with sambo throws and smothers from top; quietly one of the toughest outs.
lhw_sokolov.bio: Slams you with sambo throws and smothers from top; quietly one of the toughest outs.

lhw_coleman.name: Dre Coleman
lhw_coleman.hook: Takes you down at will and cracks you on the feet; a tricky, athletic problem.
lhw_coleman.bio: Takes you down at will and cracks you on the feet; a tricky, athletic problem.

lhw_manos.name: Kostas Manos
lhw_manos.hook: The division's measuring stick — beat Manos and you've earned your ranking.
lhw_manos.bio: The division's measuring stick — beat Manos and you've earned your ranking.

lhw_ford.name: Jaylen Ford
lhw_ford.hook: Undefeated, gifted, climbing fast — the prospect everyone's penciling in for a future title run.
lhw_ford.bio: Undefeated, gifted, climbing fast — the prospect everyone's penciling in for a future title run.

lhw_ndlovu.name: Sipho Ndlovu
lhw_ndlovu.hook: Came to the sport late but the tools are absurd; improving every single fight.
lhw_ndlovu.bio: Came to the sport late but the tools are absurd; improving every single fight.

hw_boateng.name: Malik Boateng
hw_boateng.hook: A gentle giant who shakes hands and smiles — until the bell, when one concrete right hand ends the evening.
hw_boateng.bio: A gentle giant who shakes hands and smiles — until the bell, when one concrete right hand ends the evening.
hw_boateng.hype: One concrete right hand and it's over. The scariest man in the building.

hw_morozov.name: Ivan Morozov
hw_morozov.hook: Enormous, silent, and crushing — puts giants on their backs and leaves them there.
hw_morozov.bio: Enormous, silent, and crushing — puts giants on their backs and leaves them there.

hw_tui.name: Sam Tui
hw_tui.hook: The most beloved man in the building; a mountain of a human with bowling-ball fists and a huge heart.
hw_tui.bio: The most beloved man in the building; a mountain of a human with bowling-ball fists and a huge heart.

hw_flynn.name: Connor Flynn
hw_flynn.hook: Crisp, fast hands rare for the weight — out-boxes the lumbering giants and makes it look easy.
hw_flynn.bio: Crisp, fast hands rare for the weight — out-boxes the lumbering giants and makes it look easy.

hw_reyes.name: Dominic Reyes
hw_reyes.hook: Freak athlete from the gridiron; explosive takedowns and ground-and-pound, still learning the craft.
hw_reyes.bio: Freak athlete from the gridiron; explosive takedowns and ground-and-pound, still learning the craft.

hw_nurlan.name: Bekzat Nurlan
hw_nurlan.hook: Heavy sambo top game; drags the bangers into deep water and drowns them.
hw_nurlan.bio: Heavy sambo top game; drags the bangers into deep water and drowns them.

hw_bamidele.name: Olu Bamidele
hw_bamidele.hook: Hilarious one-punch power and very little mileage — terrifying upside if he keeps developing.
hw_bamidele.bio: Hilarious one-punch power and very little mileage — terrifying upside if he keeps developing.

hw_muller.name: Hans Müller
hw_muller.hook: Been in with everyone; you have to earn every minute against the old oak.
hw_muller.bio: Been in with everyone; you have to earn every minute against the old oak.

hw_walker.name: Tane Walker
hw_walker.hook: Throws bombs from bell to bell and takes them too; pure entertainment heavyweight.
hw_walker.bio: Throws bombs from bell to bell and takes them too; pure entertainment heavyweight.

hw_mendoza.name: Carlos Mendoza
hw_mendoza.hook: Always the smaller man; survives on skill, footwork, and timing against the giants.
hw_mendoza.bio: Always the smaller man; survives on skill, footwork, and timing against the giants.
